title: Proof audit exercise
source:
Claim C001.
Let X_n be integrable real random variables with X_n -> 0 in probability.
Then E|X_n| -> 0.
Proof. For epsilon > 0, split the expectation over |X_n| <= epsilon and its complement.
This gives E|X_n| <= epsilon + P(|X_n| > epsilon).
The probability tends to zero; letting epsilon decrease to zero proves the claim.
